about: Hand-curated strikes, protests and big events for the Munich morning briefing. Edit on GitHub, then the morning script picks it up. See docs/MORNING_BRIEFING.md for every field.

events.title: Christmas market crowds at Marienplatz
events.summary: Christkindlmarkt runs from Marienplatz into the pedestrian zone. Platforms and exits at Marienplatz get very busy, especially late afternoon and at weekends.
events.advice: Avoid changing trains at Marienplatz at peak times. Odeonsplatz, Isartor or Karlsplatz are often quieter.

source.name: Munich Christmas market listings (check before travelling)

events.title: Tollwood winter festival at Theresienwiese
events.summary: Large winter festival on the Theresienwiese. Evenings are the busiest time around Theresienwiese and Schwanthalerhöhe stations.
events.advice: Expect fuller U4/U5 trains in the evening. Busiest hours are an estimate, not official opening times.

events.title: FC Bayern – Hertha BSC (DFB-Pokal) at Allianz Arena
events.summary: Kick-off 20:45. Around 75,000 fans travel mainly on the U6 via Fröttmaning before and after the match.
events.advice: If you use the U6 north of Münchner Freiheit that evening, expect very full trains from 18:30 and after full time.

events.title: FC Bayern – SC Paderborn (Bundesliga) at Allianz Arena
events.summary: Kick-off 20:30. Match-day crowds on the U6 and around Fröttmaning.
events.advice: Expect very full U6 trains around kick-off and full time.

events.title: Demonstration march Odeonsplatz → Königsplatz
events.summary: EXAMPLE for the prototype: a registered march along Brienner Straße. Surface routes nearby may be held for 30–60 minutes.
events.advice: Buses near the route may divert. The U-Bahn usually keeps running underneath.

source.name: Example only: not a real event

events.title: Warning strike: U-Bahn, tram and MVG buses
events.summary: EXAMPLE for the prototype: an announced all-day warning strike. S-Bahn and regional trains would not be affected.
events.advice: Plan around the S-Bahn, bike or walking. Check MVG for an emergency timetable the day before.

source.name: Example only: not a real strike

events.title: Lift out of service at Sendlinger Tor
events.summary: EXAMPLE for the prototype: the station is open but one lift to the U-Bahn platform is not working.
events.advice: Step-free travellers: check the MVG lift status before setting off.
